items.title: Aiuruoca (MG) IT procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 8 #108
items.en_title: Aiuruoca (MG) IT procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Dec 8 #108
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Aiuruoca (MG) is procuring IT equipment, systems or services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 36,890; proposals close Dec 8, 18:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
